cards.answer: Trundle is a fighter/tank who pressures enemies with empowered basic attacks and an area that boosts his attack speed, movement speed and healing. His attacks emphasize physical damage and AD, while his ultimate drains health through magic damage and steals resistances.
cards.counterplay: Draw him away from his domain and avoid prolonged trades while your resistances are reduced.

Trundle empowers his next basic attack
While he is within the area, he gains bonus attack speed, bonus movement speed, and increased healing from all sources.

cards.priority_reason: Establishes his attack pressure, strengthened fighting area and resistance theft.

cards.answer: King's Tribute heals Trundle whenever an enemy unit dies nearby, based on that unit's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Account for his healing when fighting near dying enemy units.

citations.quote: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

facts.claim: King's Tribute heals Trundle whenever an enemy unit dies nearby, based on that unit's maximum health.

cards.priority_reason: Nearby deaths can sustain him during a fight.

cards.answer: Chomp empowers Trundle's next basic attack with bonus physical damage and a brief slow. It resets his basic attack timer, then temporarily increases his attack damage and reduces the target's attack damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance after the bite and avoid trading basic attacks while your attack damage is reduced.

citations.quote: Trundle's next basic attack within a few seconds will deal bonus physical damage and briefly slow the target.

facts.claim: Chomp empowers Trundle's next basic attack with bonus physical damage and a brief slow.

citations.quote: Chomp resets Trundle's basic attack timer.

facts.claim: It resets his basic attack timer

citations.quote: Afterwards, Trundle gains bonus attack damage for a few seconds, during which he reduces the target's attack damage.

facts.claim: then temporarily increases his attack damage and reduces the target's attack damage

cards.priority_reason: Defines his close-range trades and weakens an opponent's attacks.

cards.answer: Frozen Domain creates an area where Trundle gains attack speed, movement speed and increased healing from all sources while inside.
cards.counterplay: Move the fight away from his domain.

citations.quote: Trundle coats the target location in ice for a period. While he is within the area, he gains bonus attack speed, bonus movement speed, and increased healing from all sources.

facts.claim: Frozen Domain creates an area where Trundle gains attack speed, movement speed and increased healing from all sources while inside.

cards.priority_reason: His area strengthens both pursuit and sustained fighting.

cards.answer: Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain and slows nearby enemies. Its placement knocks back units hit.
cards.counterplay: Leave space to move around the pillar and avoid narrow routes when he can place it.

citations.quote: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

facts.claim: Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain and slows nearby enemies.

citations.quote: Trundle erects an ice pillar at the target location that remains for a few seconds, which knocks back units hit.

facts.claim: Its placement knocks back units hit.

cards.priority_reason: Terrain, displacement and slowing directly affect escape routes.

cards.answer: Subjugate targets an enemy champion, dealing magic damage based on their maximum health and healing Trundle for the same amount. It steals armor and magic resistance, applying part of the drain and theft immediately and the rest over time; the stolen resistances persist briefly after the drain ends.
cards.counterplay: Back away while your resistances are reduced and avoid committing into his stolen defenses.

citations.quote: Trundle drains the life force of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage based on their maximum health and healing for the same amount.

citations.quote: Half of the damage and stealing is applied instantly, and the other half is applied over a few seconds.

facts.claim: applying part of the drain and theft immediately and the rest over time

citations.quote: The armor and magic resist will remain stolen for a few seconds afterwards.

facts.claim: the stolen resistances persist briefly after the drain ends

cards.priority_reason: Simultaneously weakens the target's defenses and strengthens Trundle.

cooldown_candidates.reason: Pillar availability determines his access to terrain control and displacement.
Subjugate availability substantially changes his defensive strength and threat to durable targets.
Frozen Domain availability determines access to his area-based combat bonuses.
Chomp's frequent availability matters for repeated empowered attacks and attack damage reduction.
